unlisted_practices: Adapt responsible AI frameworks for mental health and integrate them into local and international governance frameworks.
Foster ongoing collaboration among researchers, clinicians, ethicists, policy makers, and technologists on generative AI in mental health.
Rigorously validate generative AI applications in mental health before clinical integration.
Preserve human effort and empathy in therapeutic contexts rather than replacing them with generative AI.
Establish standardized processes for aligning large language models with diverse human values before integrating them into mental health care.
